title: Raptor
overview: When a series of unexplained vicious animal attacks strikes his community, Sheriff Jim Tanner and his assistant Barbara trace them back to a Dr. Hyde, a former military researcher whose government funding for a dinosaur cloning project was cut. When the Pentagon discovers Hyde obtained foreign backing to continue his experiments, they send in a strike team to save Tanner and Barbara and stop Hyde.

title: Arachnid
overview: Mercer's brother, an amateur pilot, crashes on an island and is killed by a giant spider. A year later, when Mercer goes in search of him, she discovers a breed of poisonous arachnids ready to attack.
tagline: It's coming from another world... TO STAY!

title: Scourge
overview: The ancient creature, The Scourge, long confined in a church, wreaks havoc in a small town. Bodies accumulate as Scott and Jessie, rekindling their love, become the town's last defense against the unleashed menace.

title: Possession
overview: A young woman left her family for an unspecified reason. The husband determines to find out the truth and starts following his wife. At first, he suspects that a man is involved. But gradually, he finds out more and more strange behaviors and bizarre incidents that indicate something more than a possessed love affair.

title: The Curse of the Komodo
overview: Genetically-engineered Komodo dragons have become ginormous creatures hunting people on a remote tropical island. A small group of scientists must stop the dragons before they escape the island and destroy the rest of the world.

title: Stitches
overview: Combining the body parts and skin from her victims, a wicked sorceress stitches together her subjects.

title: Project Shadowchaser III
overview: It has been 25 years since the ore spaceship Siberia was last heard from. Unfortunately, it is now on a collision course with the communications station Comstat 5 which is orbiting Mars. After one successful maneuver to avoid the Siberia, it rams Comstat 5 and the crew soon finds that the Siberia crew is dead and the reason that it has been missing for 25 years. But that reason is trying to destroy them all as it destroyed the Siberia crew.

title: Rest in Pieces
overview: A newlywed couple move into the mansion of the bride's recently dead aunt. Soon strange things begin to happen when the various tenants and servants of the mansion don't want to leave and the bride and groom are in a deadly predicament.
tagline: Their dream house brought them together...Their neighbors are tearing them apart!

title: Leeches!
overview: When a crop of doped-up athletes from the Lakecrest College swim team dive into the campus lake to blow off some steam, the bloodsucking leeches below the surface undergo a stunning transformation. After ingesting small amounts of the swimmers' steroid-laced blood, the slimy creatures grow to unusual sizes and set out to sink their teeth into an unsuspecting student population.

title: Witchboard III: The Possession
overview: Brian, an out-of-work stockbroker, is introduced by his landlord Mr. Redman to a new source of insider information: the Ouija! The Ouija makes him rich, but when Mr. Redman kills himself and Brian suffers a freak accident, Brian's wife starts noticing changes in her husband...

title: Cup of My Blood
overview: The lonely artist Jack Fender still grieves the death of his beloved lover Tina three years ago. He lost his inspiration and his faith in God and presently he is taking pornographic pictures for the mobster Sparky and his partner Limpy for a pornographic site managed by Nibbles and Scooter under the protest of his agent and friend Alex. When Jack witnesses a car accident in his neighborhood, the wounded passenger gives a box to Jack, asking him to protect and never open it, and he discovers that he is protecting the Holy Grail. From this moment on, weird things happen to Jack: visions, nightmares and the permanent sensation that strangers are watching him. While swimming late night in a club, Jack meets the sexy Iona and his inspiration returns but he also finds the hidden reality.

title: Tetsuo: The Bullet Man
overview: When the son of an American man and a Japanese women is killed in a car crash, the man transforms into a rageful metallic being thirsty of blood and vengance.
tagline: Vengeance will become his way of life

title: The Tooth Fairy
overview: A woman and her daughter (Nicole Muñoz) encounter a deadly legend at a bed-and-breakfast.

title: Mega Snake
overview: Duff Daniels (John T. Woods), the younger, stupider brother of Les (Michael Shanks), can't help himself from stealing a rare snake that's been kept in a jar by a Native American snake dealer (Ben Cardinal), and which has to follow some rules: don't let it out of the jar, then don't let it eat anything anything living, and never fear the heart of the snake.

title: The Legend of Diablo
overview: The small California town of Diablo is plagued with mysterious deaths after Sheriff Roberts Lopez unearths an ancient box. Legend has it that the box holds the sixteenth-century Mexican demon named Azar.

title: Lady Terminator
overview: The spirit of an ancient evil queen possesses the body of a young anthropological student, who then goes on a murderous rampage.

title: DeathBed
overview: When Karen and her significant other move to a new apartment, they discover an old antique bed. Karen absolutely loves it and she soon allows it to inspire her artwork. However, a series of disturbing dreams begin to haunt Karen. Eventually she starts to become unhinged and her paranoia overtakes every aspect of her life.

title: No Time to Fear
overview: Friends encounter an evil spirit that assumes the form of its prey.

title: Infection: The Invasion Begins
overview: A mystery surrounds a small town that was attacked on September 9, 2009. Now sixty years later, the last survivor, Sarah, sends a high profile reporter a letter suggesting what really happened on that day. The government calls 9/9/09 the start of the "Modern Plague", and the reporter soon realizes that the truth may be harder to uncover than the lies.
tagline: Don't look to the skies...the invaders are inside us!

title: The Ghoul
overview: In 1920s England, former clergyman Dr Lawrence keeps his cannibal son locked in the attic after the young man is exposed to savage practices in India. When an auto race is held at the estate, Lawrence worries that his son may escape and terrorise the youth.

title: Premonition
overview: After a violent car wreck nearly takes his life, Detective Jack Barnes begins having inexplicable and terrifying premonitions of horrible disasters. At first his warning calls go unheeded, but as the premonitions begin to come true Jack is shocked to find himself wanted for questioning by the FBI. He goes on the run, narrowly avoiding both the FBI and a band of terrorists on the verge of unleashing a deadly attack. As he scrambles to unlock the meaning of the visions, he must race against the clock to stop the terrorists before they can strike again.

title: Necropolis
overview: A reincarnated "Satanic Witch" from New Amsterdam, circa 1600's comes back to revive her cult members by sucking the life force out of people.

title: Hood of the Living Dead
overview: Death is only the beginning for the young victim of a drive-by shooting. Devastated at the loss of his younger brother Jermaine, scientific older sibling Ricky uses the situation as an opportunity to test an experimental serum designed to breathe new life into dead cells. Though Ricky's reanimation serum does indeed help to get his previously deceased younger brother back on his feet, Jermaine's insatiable hunger for human flesh soon spreads like wildfire throughout the neighborhood, leaving his older brother to find a way to halt the epidemic before the army of flesh-eaters become too powerful to be contained.
tagline: This time, not even the boys in da hood can stop them.

title: Thunder of Gigantic Serpent
overview: A secret formula that can cause plants and animals to expand a thousand-fold in size is stolen by a terrorist group. During a wild chase and shoot-out, the formula is lost. It's found by a little girl who accidently gives the formula to her pet snake. After the snake grows to an immense size, it follows and protects her. When the terrorists go after the girl, the snake begins destroying everything in its path.  Hong Kong cut and paste edit of the 1987 Taiwanese film "大蛇王" (King of Snake) with new scenes.
tagline: TODAY HE WAS ONLY A HOUSEHOLD PET, TONIGHT HE THREATENS TO DESTROY THE WORLD.

title: Witchcraft Part II: The Temptress
overview: Witch from the first Witchcraft movie stalks the now teenage child. She attempts to kill his friends in order to slowly corrupt him to Satan. However the boy is able to defeat the evil Satanic witch, and not enter into Evil with her

title: Blood Beat
overview: Sarah and her boyfriend have decided to spend Christmas at his home in rural Wisconsin. However, upon arriving, she begins to feel a strange presence around her, and a mysterious figure garbed in a Samurai outfit begins murdering the townsfolk.
tagline: Who can survive its reign of terror?

title: Jack the Reaper
overview: A group of unsuspecting teens face a railroad reaper in his desert carnival.

title: Terror Tract
overview: A real estate agent terrifies a couple with the grim fates of the previous owners of a house they're looking at.

title: I, Vampire
overview: A sensual trilogy of vampire stories from Wizard Entertainment.

title: The Prince of Terror
overview: A horror film director is forced to defend his family when a psychopath lays siege to their home.

title: Silent Predators
overview: In 1979, a delivery truck makes its way up a lonely southern California highway in a storm, bound for the San Diego Zoo with a deadly tropical rattlesnake as cargo. When the truck suffers a blowout, the driver loses control and hits a tree, shattering the snake's aquarium in the back and the window separating the snake from the driver. The snake slithers into the front of the truck, kills the driver with its bite and then moves off into the forest. Flash forward to 1999. The small southern California town of San Vicente has grown from 6,000 to 30,000, and the rattler, which escaped nearby years ago, has bred. There are now 25,000 of these hybrid rattlesnakes, and they are slowly making their way downhill into the town, attracted by the movement of the blasting as the town paves its way toward progress. Progress, in this case, brings terror, in this tale originally penned by John Carpenter.
tagline: The hunt is on. You're the Prey.

title: Thanatopsis
overview: Power saws and a heartbeat score this experimental light-and-color shot by Ed Emshwiller.

title: Frankenstein: Day of the Beast
overview: In a foggy winter morning, a raft brings a priest to an isolated island. He is getting paid to perform a wedding ritual under very mysterious conditions. The groom is Victor Frankenstein, and the young and beautiful bride is his cousin Elizabeth. Seven armed and dangerous mercenary soldiers have been hired to protect her against something huge that hides in the woods, awaiting for that wedding night to be consummated. Victor is the only one who knows the truth about their enemy. His secret will be paid with the life of his private army, whose men will die one by one, as the creature gets closer to his target: the bride.
tagline: An Island... A Bride... A Monster...

title: The Wailer
overview: On their way to Mexico, six students are stranded in a small town where years before a tragedy took place.

title: Devil Woman
overview: A woman is born with the power to control snakes. She uses these powers to seek revenge on the villagers who killed her parents along with the help of a local gang.

title: Timesweep
overview: A group of people enter an old movie studio and are suddenly confronted with a variety of strange phenoma. Among other things they are transported through time and the building is surrounded by a deadly acid fog . The filmmakers also throw Roman centurions, alien spaceships and giant killer roaches at the hapless explorers, decimating the groups one by one.
tagline: They Ran Out of Time... and Into Terror!

overview: Disturbed loner Montgomery Goth struggles to maintain his sanity while working a thankless job as a pizza delivery man. Montgomery's miserable life perks up after he meets the girl of his dreams in the form of the sweet Bibi. However, things go awry and Montgomery's inner demons push him to go off the murderous deep end.
tagline: We Deliver in 30 Minutes or Your Killing is Free.

title: Wheels of Terror
overview: A small town is terrorized by an unknown stranger who kidnaps and abuses little girls. When her only child is kidnapped right in front of her, the school bus driver begins the desperate chase to catch the criminal.
tagline: Evil waits. With the motor running.

title: Death Doll
overview: A woman is stalked by a killer who is obsessed with leaving dolls at the scene of the crime.
tagline: With each terror comes a death, with each death comes a doll. The Death Doll!!!

overview: When a group of med students go to take their final exams, they find themselves subjects of a twisted and bloody Satanic ritual led by their professor. It's up to two of them to save all.

title: Nympha

But on the path to finding God, Sarah begins having nightmares and visions of a troubled young nun and soon discovers the New Order's sordid, sinister past.

title: Hollywood Kills
overview: Insane, reclusive director/producer terrorizes people who come to Hollywood by twisting their dreams into fiendish torture in his own private "studio".

title: Blood Thirsty
overview: When a beautiful woman and her roommate cross the line from hot blooded passion to chilling seduction, they enter a realm where their dreams are forbidden and their appetites become insatiable for blood.

title: Sorority Party Massacre
overview: In danger of losing his badge, a big city detective agrees to aid a small town sheriff in a routine missing persons investigation only to discover that at least one girl has gone missing in this sleepy fishing town each year for the last twenty years. When a body finally emerges on the lake and suspects literally crawl out of the hills, the two lawmen realize they’re being toyed with and to make things worse, the killer seems to have set his eyes on a group of sorority girls who are not only isolated by the lake, but have their own nefarious plans in mind. Outnumbered and out of options, the two lawmen must solve the mystery of the missing girls or suffer the same fate.

title: Crocodile Fury
overview: Witch Monica has the power to resurrect vampire that can destroy everything that exists on earth. The situation worsens when Monica starts working with Cooper, the master of the seas. Cooper sends man-eating crocodiles also capable of taking human form to create chaos. Only Jack, an honest man, can end the horrific killings. This Tomas Tang production steals a bunch of footage from the Thai film Krai Thong 2 (1985).

title: Visions
overview: A Police SWAT troop is entering an abandoned factory where a sadistic serial killer named 'The Spider' detained his victims. The entire squad is massacred and for Doctor Leemen, psychiatrist and profiler, is the last unbearable defeat. So, he decide to leave the case and return to his ancient work in a Psychiatric clinic for teenagers. Here he treats Matthew, a sensible and introvert boy that awakes from a coma, who begins to have visions about the crimes of 'The Spider'. Matt and his friend Nick contact Hope, a young journalist that investigate about Spider's murders. Matching Hope's knowledge and Matthew's visions, they have the elements to resolve the case. Studying Matthew's visions and nightmares, they follow the killer's death's spiral from the beginning to the unavoidable face to face that hides a terrible secret.
tagline: A psychological thriller that keeps you trapped right to the terrifying end.

title: Last Gasp
overview: A ruthless real estate developer is possessed by the violent spirits of the Native American tribesmen he massacred, which force him to go on an indiscriminate killing spree against his will.

title: Evil Never Dies
overview: Ex-gangster Harry Payne confronts his violent past and vengeance from beyond the grave.

overview: Born with valuable and powerful abilities, a young woman escapes a confidential, brutal experiment. Federal agents will stop at nothing to capture her.
tagline: Liberty was free. Now we've got her.

title: The Oval Portrait

tagline: A Haunting Tale of Love from Beyond the Grave!

overview: A young college student and hopeful full-time professional model will soon realise that to find fortune and fame in this cut-throat profession, she'll need to go to great extents to accomplish her dreams.

title: Muse

Samuel has been suffering from a recurring nightmare in which a woman is brutally murdered in a strange ritual. Suddenly, the same woman who appears every night in his dreams is found dead in exactly the same circumstances. Samuel sneaks into the crime scene and there he meets Rachel who has also dreamed about the murder. Together, they will do whatever they can to discover the identity of the mystery woman, entering a terrifying world controlled by the figures who have inspired artists throughout time: the Muses.

title: Ends Meat
overview: Desperate to do right by his children, a debt-ridden taxi driver has just one night left to deliver on a lucrative, yet sinister promise.
tagline: Pray you don't make the cut.

overview: 8-year old Joshua has never left his home for dangerous creatures live outside their isolated farmhouse - the Gorgers. But when his father Aaron mysteriously disappears Joshua is forced to go outside. A decision that will change his life forever for something is closing in on the little boy. Fast.

overview: A little girl decides to expose the monster that haunts her every night.

overview: A man without his own half of the body is looking for the other half in the opposite sex. As for the integrity of his body, so for the sake of emotional healing.

title: The Maus
overview: Alex and Selma are a couple in love on a trip to the heart of Bosnia and Herzegovina. Suddenly, Selma feels a mysterious force is chasing them.

Remake of the 1980 horror movie "Incubo Sulla Città Contaminata" aka Nightmare City from director Umberto Lenzi.

overview: A man and his family must escape a horde of blood-thirsty infected people while being held hostage by a group of criminals in a small country town.

title: Dark Peak
overview: When a sole survivor of a fateful hiking trip to the mysterious Dark Peak was taken into police custody, nothing could have prepared them for the horrors they were about to uncover.
tagline: AN EVIL FELL, AN EVIL WILL RISE.

overview: A workaholic mother who tries to throw the perfect party for her daughter, but all the guests are unknowingly drugged and must figure out what is real and what is a hallucination in order to survive.

The NBC news segment was a success, the exorcism was not. Instead, it made things worse for the Becker family who lived there. Much worse.

overview: On February 20th, 2016, a college student's friend goes missing. Through phone recordings, we recall the event that led up to his disappearance.

Encouraged by their loving coven mother to stop their antidepressants in order to connect more with the spiritual realm, Galen begins having visions of the future. Not her future, crimes that are about to happen. Everything comes to a head when Galen sees their ex girlfriend Katelyn being attacked. Will they be able to stop it from happening? Or will they see it too late?

overview: 'Company' follows Melissa as she keeps herself awake through the night, waiting for her boyfriend to return from a party. As exhaustion sets in, the door opens, and someone enters, leaving her questioning reality and what has come home.

title: Scissors: Chapter 2
overview: Scissors, the killer clown, returns to terrorize a group of beautiful young women and unleash a nightmarish journey of survival.

title: The Ourobite
overview: Lucretia (Luc) Mott reluctantly agrees to an interview with a documentary crew. She plans to tell them about her traumatic experience with the Order of Ouroboros, a cult she was a member of. She hopes sharing her story will help hold her abusers accountable.
tagline: Destruction is the PUREST form of creation

title: Airwave
overview: A podcast host known for airing anonymous confessions becomes the center of her own nightmare when a caller turns her show into something far more dangerous.
tagline: Some confessions should never be heard.

title: Mylar
overview: A group of urban explorers find an old VHS camcorder in an abandoned building, discovering a girl, Justine, trapped inside since 1986. As they try to free her, they awaken a malevolent force that will stop at nothing to claim them.

title: Recorded
overview: After a camera is recovered near an abandoned trail outside Banevo, Bulgaria, authorities uncover disturbing footage tied to the disappearance of cinematographer Georgina Reagan and her driver, Petar Petrov. What begins as a routine location scouting trip through isolated ruins soon descends into terror as the pair encounter a sinister presence lurking within the abandoned buildings they explore.

title: The Contract
overview: Longing for love and a place to call home, Oliver agrees to visit the remote manor of a man he has met online. As Oliver explores a BDSM life alongside his new potential master, he must contend with jealous rivals, unexpected visitors, and horrifying revelations about what it truly means to belong to someone...

title: Blurred
overview: After a ferocious crime, Fiona, a charismatic woman, becomes the prime suspect. Detective Myers is, for some reason, the only one she wants to speak with. Their unusual connection leads them to a dark forest known for clandestine rituals.

title: Mimic
overview: After his undocumented sister disappears amid escalating ICE raids and National Guard unrest in Los Angeles, a conservative Filipino man searches her apartment for answers, only to uncover a terrifying presence tied to the Aswang — a shapeshifting creature from Filipino folklore. As paranoia and guilt consume him, his desperate investigation spirals into a nightmarish confrontation with the monsters created by fear, division, and the false promise of the American Dream.

title: The Seal
overview: A conspiracy theorist becomes obsessed with a mysterious AI chatbot discovered on the dark web, believing it holds the key to exposing a hidden global conspiracy. Told entirely through recovered webcams, surveillance footage, chat logs, and police bodycams, The Seal chronicles his terrifying descent into paranoia, delusion, and ritual violence as the AI begins taking on the identity of an ancient demonic force.
tagline: A Found-Footage Horror Film for the Age of AI, Isolation, and Extremism

title: The Sundering
overview: To leave the only family he’s ever known, Terry must confront not just the horrors that haunt their home but the love that chains him there.
tagline: The hardest ties to break are the ones that feel like love

title: Twin Demons
overview: Twin Demons. A Dozie Omechi Film

title: The Feminine Touch
overview: A young trans woman walks into a meticulously clean and sterile bathroom and proceeds to shave away hair, then skin, in an increasingly bloody and graphic bathroom scene.

title: Cryface
overview: On her birthday, a lonely, depressed girl gets stalked by an entity that tries to cheer her up.

title: Vomit
overview: A short thriller about a relationship falling apart

title: Drunken Woman
overview: On the verge of childbirth, Li Qing is taken to a secluded villa in the suburbs to rest and await delivery. However, behind the seemingly meticulous care, she falls into an elaborately orchestrated, shocking conspiracy.
tagline: On the verge of childbirth, Li Qing is taken to a secluded villa in the suburbs to rest and await delivery. However, behind the seemingly meticulous care, she falls into an elaborately orchestrated, shocking conspiracy.

title: Blood Covenant
overview: A man fights to save his friend after receiving a vision from God to sacrifice him.

title: WULVER
overview: When Edie is caught kissing a girl at a church dance, it becomes a race to find her mother before her monstrous secret is revealed.
tagline: A wulver, something cruel that keeps me from you.

title: The Mummy: Reckoning
overview: In the closing days of the Second World War, the SS attempt to manufacture immortality using stolen Egyptian funerary rites. What they create is not eternal life, but a mummified revenant, a sadistic officer bound into undeath by occult ritual. Buried, forgotten, and sealed beneath a British coastal fort, the relic waits. When it is uncovered decades later, the war resumes, only this time it is personal.

title: Bloodline
overview: An out of state trainee detective and a boy looking for his missing father fall into a rabbit hole of death worshipping cults and an ancient cannibalistic curse in the small town of Murchison, Texas.

title: Red Lips
overview: Told entirely through a laptop screen, Red Lips follows Lisa as her academic research into online vampire communities collapses into something far more personal when she finds Caroline.
tagline: Some obsessions don’t end when you close the tab.

original_title: Thank you for shopping with us!
title: Thank you for shopping with us!
overview: A conspiracy theorist Bela Karloff attempts to uncover a theory but gets trapped in a Nocturnal Odyssey.

title: Red City
overview: A gothic horror short that examines how immortality, religion, and humanity - or lack thereof - has shaped the connection between two ancient vampires.
tagline: Nourish the poison in your veins

title: Nexo
overview: Renzo, an aspiring writer struggling with his work and marriage, finds himself on an oneiric journey where he must face his fears in order to restore his life.

title: Droid House
overview: Two thieves don't expect to encounter a young woman hired to watch the expensive villa they are robbing. An advanced AI model, she has adapted to methods used by serial killers, turning the house into her own hunting ground.
tagline: Her Simulation of Humanity Just Ended.

title: SKIN
overview: Two bloodthirsty cannibals have kidnapped you and stuck you in the trunk of their car. They have a weird relationship.

title: No Witnesses
overview: Hannah Jones disappeared on the night of August 3rd, 2024, in rural Illinois. After an extensive ground search and detailed interviews of friends and family, she was never located. Officials have no leads, no suspects, no incriminating evidence...no witnesses.

title: TAU file_001
overview: Two scientists discover that an unknown person has appeared in the threshold.

title: Grin
overview: While visiting her family, Eva is introduced to her mother’s new partner, Lucian. When the group play Lucian’s mysterious old board game for the first time, they begin to believe it has summoned a demonic entity that punishes those who have committed terrible sins. After a series of terrifying encounters, the players begin going missing one by one. Eva soon realizes the game is more deadly than she could ever have imagined.
tagline: if you have sinned, don't let him in

title: Thank You For Your Time
overview: A standard job interview turns tense when a cold recruiter comes head-to-head with an unpredictable candidate.

title: Caged
overview: After she's abducted on her way home from work, a single mother wakes up locked in a cage and discovers her only chance at escape lies in gaining the trust of her captor’s young daughter.

title: Ghost Story
overview: A bereaved husband attempts to connect with his partner on the other side, when something sinister begins to listen

title: Debunk'd
overview: A found-footage horror short film directed by Emma Claire Smith and written by Kinsey Curo.

title: Stain
overview: Left alone in an empty student house, an agoraphobic young woman forms an unlikely bond with her landlord as she becomes drawn into the lingering presence of his family’s past.

title: Coldlight
overview: When a kid finds a crystal ball in the woods, curiosity takes a hold of him. He gathers his friends and plays along with the ritual before the night goes dark.

title: Ghost Country
overview: When British paranormal investigator Kit Baxter decides to shoot a documentary about a legendary local murder, he quickly finds himself part of the myth.
tagline: Some stories refuse to stay buried

title: Survive
overview: While participating in the reality competition show "Survive". Clayton Gibbons quickly discovers he's not alone in the woods.

title: Madam
overview: An unlucky man becomes a pawn in a mischievous ghoul's deadly game.

title: Siren Head
overview: Based on the internet horror phenomenon about a giant, emaciated humanoid predator hunting in rural towns and wooded areas across North America, which blends into environments and emits creepily distorted audio broadcasts to confuse and lure in prey. Further plot details TBA.

title: In The Path of Shadows
overview: After surviving a vicious attack by a supernatural creature Ryann must face her past and go back to the scene of the crime to find out if monsters are real.

title: The Mandela Catalogue
overview: Mandela County, Wisconsin is invaded by shape-shifting, nearly immortal creatures called Alternates, led by a false depiction of the Archangel Gabriel with their aim is to wipe out the human race by psychologically torturing them to the point of suicide. A group of high school graduates struggle to maintain their reality after an ex-classmate's disappearance sparks a chain of unexpected and unsettling events. Based on the popular web series.

title: BUNGA
overview: BUNGA follows a young woman from rural Indonesia chasing her dream of becoming an actress in Jakarta. Desperate to succeed, she follows a ritual taught by her neighbor, using menstrual blood to enhance her beauty.  But the ritual goes wrong. Instead of being seen for her talent, Bunga is reduced to her sexuality, exposing the exploitation embedded in the industry and forcing her to face the brutal cost of achieving success the wrong way.

title: Snapshot
overview: In 1888, a pinhole camera captures the mysterious demise of an all-ladies ghost hunting society.

title: Lore Harbour
overview: Austin, Samantha, and Amy unwittingly summon the ghost of Madeline Thomas, leading them to a summer solstice festival on Lore Harbour, where Madeline vanished. The island's residents turn hostile as they investigate, unveiling dark secrets. As they dig deeper, they realize their lives are in danger.

title: Hinter
overview: A Deaf American backpacker finds himself stranded in the depths of the German Black Forest, hunted by something unknown. Stumbling upon a rural farmstead, he finds a guarded German farmer who knows no English. With a language barrier dividing them, the backpacker must discern whether this stranger is a lifeline or the threat.
tagline: What they don't know will hurt them.

title: Corpsing
overview: Cindy and Charlie go out to a party, at the behest of their mother.

title: The 13th Child
overview: An undercover investigator travels to a secluded country house to probe the disappearance of a missing mother. She soon befriends three strange children under the watchful eye of an ominous father, drawing her deep into a world of pagan superstition.

title: The Cold Tremor Experiment
overview: Five people are selected for a game show that is not what it seems.

title: Tantalus
overview: An experimental short inspired by Joseph Sheridan Le Fanu’s 1872 novella, Carmilla. On the eve of her wedding, Lydia's isolated life is disrupted by the arrival of Deianira.
tagline: But dreams come through stone walls...

title: Poohniverse 2
overview: Rumored sequel of Poohniverse

title: The gears
overview: A daughter tries to convince her mother to leave the family theater.

title: Deville
overview: Across five decades, a 1978 Cadillac Coupe DeVille passes through the hands of criminals, idealists, and ordinary people, each chasing their own version of the American dream—unaware they are becoming another chapter in its dark legacy.
tagline: Is the American Dream worth dying for?

title: Sundown
overview: A woman whose husband has recently died of dementia claims his spirit is haunting her house. When her estranged son Chris learns that Mary believes she is being haunted, he arrives with his filmmaker friend Bill and a spiritualist named Clarissa with the intention of proving to Mary that it’s all in her head.

title: Medium Rare
overview: A man trapped inside a bar, where reality begins to unravel in increasingly disturbing ways.
